visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a brown silk camisole, holds a gold-capped glass bottle of ROOTON body oil. She sprays a fine mist onto her chest. The lighting is warm and soft, highlighting the texture of her skin and the mist as it disperses. (2) Close-up on the woman's shoulder and neck. Her hands, with light pink manicured nails, gently massage the transparent oil into her skin using smooth circular motions. The background is a soft-focus indoor setting, emphasizing her relaxed expression. (3) The scene shifts to a brightly lit bathroom. The woman, now wearing a white bathrobe, stands before a mirror drying her hair with a white towel. On the bathroom counter, several white and amber ROOTON brand skincare pump bottles are neatly arranged. (4) In a bedroom setting, the woman sits on the edge of a bed covered in white linens. She sprays the oil onto her forearm and massages it in. A small, modern gold lamp glows softly on the nightstand behind her. (5) A close-up shows the ROOTON body oil bottle sitting on a white ceramic tray next to a curved wooden massage tool. The woman's hands apply oil to her calf and then use the wooden tool to perform a firm massage stroke up her leg. (6) The final scene shows the woman sitting comfortably on a light grey fabric couch in a living room. She leans back with a peaceful expression, touching her hair. The ROOTON body oil bottle is displayed prominently on a tray in the foreground.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a gentle, high-fidelity acoustic guitar melody accompanied by soft piano chords. The tempo is a relaxed 85 BPM. There are no vocals or ambient noises, creating a studio-clean, peaceful atmosphere perfect for a wellness theme. (2) A sharp, percussive 'click' sound effect coincides with a visual cut, acting as a rhythmic transition. The background music continues its warm, melodic progression without interruption. The spectral balance is weighted toward warm mid-frequencies. (3) Successive percussive 'click' and 'impact' SFX continue to punctuate the rapid visual editing. These sounds have high transient energy but short duration, ensuring they emphasize the cuts without overwhelming the soothing BGM. No background chatter is detected. (4) The BGM remains steady as the woman is seen in different home settings. Each 'click' transition is clean and crisp, indicating a professional post-production mix. The acoustic texture remains smooth and consistent throughout the middle section of the video. (5) As the brand logo and product are shown finally, the acoustic music reaches a natural harmonic resolution. A final, subtle percussive beat marks the end of the narrative, and the audio fades out into a clean silence with no technical artifacts.
